# Data present
- `olink_*`: Accessory files made available by Olink.

# Data absent
- `olink_assay_warning.dat`: Gives warnings for each protein and instance in each plate.
- `olink_limit_of_detection.dat`: Lists limit of detection for every data point in each plate.

# Participant-level data removed
- `proteomics_npx_data_off_dnanexus.csv`: protein measurments.
- `proteomics_non_npx_data_off_dnanexus.csv`: non-protein, i.e. technical factor, measurements.
- `proteomics_phenotype_file_off_dnanexus`: all phenotypes.
